text: outside of [[Makkah|مَكَّة]]. So she kept her son with her outside of [[Makkah|مَكَّة]].
And the father of this boy, [[Hashim|هَاشِم]], had already died.
Now, when this boy grew up, when [[Shaybah|شَيْبَة]] grew up, when he became adolescent, when he reached maturity,

his uncle, [[al-Muttalib|الْمُطَّلِب]], and [[al-Muttalib|الْمُطَّلِب]] was another one of the sons of [[Abd Manaf|عَبْد مَنَاف]], and [[al-Muttalib|الْمُطَّلِب]] was the brother of [[Hashim|هَاشِم]].

So [[Hashim|هَاشِم]] passed away, and [[Hashim|هَاشِم]]'s son [[Shaybah|شَيْبَة]] is growing up with his mother outside of [[Makkah|مَكَّة]]. [[al-Muttalib|الْمُطَّلِب]] is still there in [[Makkah|مَكَّة]].
Now when [[Shaybah|شَيْبَة]] becomes mature, when he becomes an adolescent, his uncle [[al-Muttalib|الْمُطَّلِب]] comes from [[Makkah|مَكَّة]] to take the boy back to [[Makkah|مَكَّة]].
So he comes to the mother's house and says, 'I want to take my nephew, [[Shaybah|شَيْبَة]], back to [[Makkah|مَكَّة]] with me.'
And she said, 'No, how can you take my son away from me?'

And then [[al-Muttalib|الْمُطَّلِب]] said that, 'Your son, the son of my brother [[Hashim|هَاشِم]], he is a leader, and he cannot stay outside of [[Makkah|مَكَّة]]. He is from the leading family, and he needs to go back to [[Makkah|مَكَّة]] now that he has reached age.'

So the mother said, 'Okay, let's leave it in his choice. Let him do whatever he wants to do. Let the boy decide for himself. If he wants to stay with me, he can stay with me. If he wants to go with you, he can go with you.' So they gave the choice to [[Shaybah|شَيْبَة]].

And [[Shaybah|شَيْبَة]] said, 'I'm going to go back to [[Makkah|مَكَّة]] with my uncle, [[al-Muttalib|الْمُطَّلِب]].' Because he wanted to be part of that honor of leading [[Makkah|مَكَّة]] and taking care of [[Makkah|مَكَّة]]. He didn't want to just stay outside with his mother.
So he goes with his uncle [[al-Muttalib|الْمُطَّلِب]], and they enter back into [[Makkah|مَكَّة]].
Now, it was known those days that slavery was very common, and the people would go outside of [[Makkah|مَكَّة]] and they would buy slaves and they would come back into [[Makkah|مَكَّة]].

So when [[al-Muttalib|الْمُطَّلِب]] came back with his nephew into [[Makkah|مَكَّة]]—and his nephew's name was [[Shaybah|شَيْبَة]]—when [[al-Muttalib|الْمُطَّلِب]] came back with his nephew [[Shaybah|شَيْبَة]] back into [[Makkah|مَكَّة]], the people see [[al-Muttalib|الْمُطَّلِب]] with this young boy, they don't know who he is, they think, 'Oh, [[al-Muttalib|الْمُطَّلِب]] has gone outside of [[Makkah|مَكَّة]] to buy a slave, and he's bringing his slave back into [[Makkah|مَكَّة]].'

So they call this young boy, they say he is [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]]. He is [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]], the slave of [[al-Muttalib|الْمُطَّلِب]], even though that was not his name. His name was [[Shaybah|شَيْبَة]], but he became known as [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] because of that.
And [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]], as you know, he is the grandfather of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ.

Now [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]], he had many sons. He had ten sons and he had six daughters. So he had sixteen children: ten sons and six daughters. And amongst his sons was the father of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ, [[Abdullah|عبد الله]] [[ibn|بن]] [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]].

So now we can get an idea of the lineage of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ a little bit, right? So we have [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ: [[Muhammad|مُحَمَّد]] [[ibn|بن]] [[Abdullah|عبد الله]] [[ibn|بن]] [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] [[ibn|بن]] [[Hashim|هَاشِم]] [[ibn|بن]] [[Abd Manaf|عَبْد مَنَاف]] [[ibn|بن]] [[Qusay|قُصَي]] [[ibn|بن]] [[Kilab|كِلَاب]].

This is the lineage of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ: [[Muhammad|مُحَمَّد]] [[ibn|بن]] [[Abdullah|عبد الله]] [[ibn|بن]] [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] [[ibn|بن]] [[Hashim|هَاشِم]] [[ibn|بن]] [[Abd Manaf|عَبْد مَنَاف]] [[ibn|بن]] [[Qusay|قُصَي]] [[ibn|بن]] [[Kilab|كِلَاب]].

So [[insha'Allah|إن شاء الله]], next week we will talk about [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] and we will talk about how he rediscovered the well of [[Zamzam|زمزم]]. The well of [[Zamzam|زمزم]] was buried for centuries, and how, what is the story of [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] rediscovering that well. We will talk about that next week, [[insha'Allah|إن شاء الله]].

translit: Wallahu a'lam, wa sallallahu wa sallama wa baraka 'ala nabiyyina Muhammadin wa 'ala alihi wa sahbihi ajma'in.
